description:
Sponsored by Zocdoc. Taking care of your health just got easier, start here at: https://zocdoc.com/GoodWork 

Ahhh San Francisco. The Golden City leads the world in many things: technology, bridges, and probably other stuff too. But it’s allegedly one of the worst places on Earth to date. 

Dan Toomey takes the GW Investigative Plane to Hill City to see if it really deserves the name “Man Francisco” and if “SF” is really short for “Sausage Fest”

Featuring interviews with

Kylie Robison, writer at host at Core Memory. Follow Kylie: https://x.com/kyliebytes

Celeste Amadon, founder of Known: https://known.com/ 

Lisa Catalano, creator of https://www.marrylisa.com/ 

Reagan Hsu, young man in SF. Follow Reagan or ask him out: https://www.youtube.com/@ReaganHsu123

Rachel Dec, writer in SF. Read Rachel’s stuff here: https://rachdele.substack.com/ 

Special thanks to Jack Raines. Check out his stuff and new book at https://www.youngmoney.co/
